cases.goal: clearing the screen and filling large rectangles
cases.name: clear-fill

protocol.caveat: Times measured on an emulator (PRG32-QT, QEMU) depend on the host computer and on the emulator; they are not the times of a PRG32 console, and a faster or slower emulator run says nothing about the console. Only a prg32 target is a physical device.
protocol.granularity: PRG32 performance broker ABI 1 keeps one summary per case (mean, percentiles over its frames), not every frame: one run gives one value per case and metric. The statistics are over runs.
protocol.repetition: the slot is selected again (POST /api/games/select): the cartridge starts from init and runs the suite once
protocol.retrieval: GET /api/performance.json, every 2 seconds, until a result with a new run_id
protocol.same_bytes: The kit builds this source; the cartridge's SHA-256 is recorded with every run. Runs are compared only when their cartridges have the same SHA-256.
protocol.timing_source: PRG32-QT's clock for the cartridge, read with prg32_perf_now_us(): the host computer's time
protocol.title: PRG32 Evaluation
